Leyland Trade 5Ltr slate semi-gloss anti slip floor paint is a tough and durable solvent-based coating designed for interior concrete, steel, and wooden floors. This high-performance floor paint features a light aggregate, providing slip-resistance for busy workshops and garages. It delivers a smart slate grey semi-gloss finish, offering both protection and an improved safety surface. With a coverage of 11 m²/Ltr, a 5Ltr tin can cover up to 55m²s, and it is recoatable after 16 hours, ensuring efficient project completion for trade professionals.
